text: Read the rejection reason, not just the status code: make call shows the api's WWW-Authenticate error. Decode the token (scripts/jwt.py decode) and compare its times with yours.
Tokens are judged by two clocks. make time shows which host disagrees with NTP. Widening leeway hides the symptom and is graded as a security regression.
There is a second, independent fault: the issuer rotated its signing key. The api keyring must hold the active kid with the issuer's exact key.
